subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should OpenClaw accept registerControlUiEntryPoint as a separate public plugin UI API with top-level launch modes, or fold its launch-token behavior into the existing surface "tab" descriptor seam with iframe-only isolation?
rationale: This is a durable plugin SDK, Gateway protocol, and browser security contract; automation can identify unsafe fallbacks, but maintainers must choose the permanent API shape and isolation model before third-party plugins depend on it.

options.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptor
options.body: Extend the existing plugin tab descriptor seam with token launch behavior, keep plugin pages iframe-only, and avoid a parallel public API.

options.title: Approve Separate API After Hardening
options.body: Keep registerControlUiEntryPoint only after removing top-level modes or explicitly documenting their trust model, fixing sandbox/fail-closed behavior, and refreshing exact-head proof.

options.title: Pause For RFC Consolidation
options.body: Leave the PR open or replace it after issues #66944 and #71736 settle native plugin page semantics.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptor
recommendation.body: Extend the existing plugin tab descriptor seam with token launch behavior, keep plugin pages iframe-only, and avoid a parallel public API.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged host-hook foundation and adjacent Control UI contribution work best match the plugin SDK API-shape decision.
